articles.title: Stanley Druckenmiller's first X post backs Hyperliquid venture after $23 million indirect investment
articles.snippet: The billionaire investor disclosed an investment in Trade[XYZ] as the platform teams up with the NYSE's parent company. His family office previously reported owning shares in a HYPE-focused treasury company.

articles.title: Polymarket brings ultra-short crypto prediction markets to U.S. platform
articles.snippet: Polymarket’s new Up/Down crypto contracts come as the CFTC renews scrutiny of the prediction market’s compliance with its 2022 U.S. onboarding terms.

articles.title: Chainlink adds weekend pricing for tokenized assets, with Aave as launch partner
articles.snippet: The service uses perpetual futures quotes to update reference prices when traditional markets close.

articles.title: Live updates: Crypto falls amid report of multi-billion Binance hack
articles.snippet: Strategy's STRC has hit its highest price since May, and the company could soon be ready to restart large bitcoin purchases.

articles.title: Thai Supreme Court rules bitcoin is property after thief challenges conviction
articles.snippet: The court said bitcoin has a market price, can be cashed out and held by the public. It upheld a 10-year sentence for a man who helped the robbers.
